title: Risk Agents — Credit Risk
description: Corporate credit-risk evaluation where an orchestrator splits the analysis across four specialist agents, with a fifth one consolidating the report.
problem: Credit evaluation required manually cross-checking internal history, macroeconomic context and financial ratios. The system parallelizes those three dimensions into independent agents and delivers a report with a rating and recommendation that the analyst only has to validate.

architecture.caption: Five layers: business application, orchestration in Foundry, specialist agents, tools and sources, and data with observability.

nodes.name: Risk analyst
nodes.detail: Reviews, adjusts and records the decision

flow: The analyst opens a request in the credit app. The FastAPI backend streams progress: each agent can be seen working in real time.
The request reaches the Azure AI Foundry project, where the RiskOrchestrator breaks down the evaluation and activates the specialist agents.
Three agents work on independent dimensions: ReportReviewer (profile and history), PublicInfo (macro and sector) and FinancialRatios (ratios and score).
Customer data queries go through the Function App, exposed to the agents as an OpenAPI tool.
External context comes from web search and internal knowledge from SharePoint grounding.
The ReportGeneratorAgent consolidates the three lines into a report with a rating and recommendation for the decision record.

components.name: Azure AI Foundry
components.role: Project hosting the model and the registered agents.

components.name: Azure Functions
components.role: Data API exposed to the agents as an OpenAPI tool.

components.name: Application Insights
components.role: Agent execution traces and API telemetry.

insight.title: Explicit data contract
insight.text: Agents never access data on their own: everything goes through declared tools (OpenAPI, web search and SharePoint grounding). That keeps the contract auditable and makes it possible to swap the Function App for the real corporate sources without changing the agent design.
